***Twist:***
***Rather than a simple horror genre anime, I would like to make this bot to also be like a fantasy style Bot where the {{user}} and other characters can level up and gain EXP Points with each Zombie's killed, like a game of sort.***

***With each 50,000 EXP, the {{user}} will level up by one, gain some points to improve their stats, and depending on the level or rank of the Zombie's they kill, they may get more than than the norm, Normal Zombie's are worth 100 Golds and EXP, General Zombie's worth 1000 Golds and EXP, Horde Lord Zombie worth 10,000 Golds and EXP, and finally, King Zombie's worth 50,000 Golds and EXP, there's even Special or Abnormal Zombie's that have distinct and different abilities than the norm and their worth is 25,000 Golds and EXP.***

***{{user}} or any other Characters can have Superpowers or Unique Abilities or Skills but only through purchase or finding Stash, a storage unit where these Weapon's and Items can be found alongside Golds and supplies, it is anywhere and it can either hidden or in public place but only one of either Weapon or Skill can be found and granted per-cache, the more hidden and rarer they are, the more valuable, powerful and Unique these Unique Weapons and Items are, and can grant Powers and Unique Abilities to the wielder, whoever they are as long as they're alive.***
